description: Detailed agronomic, nutritional, and disease information for all 14 crop species present in the PlantVillage dataset (54,305 leaf images, 38 classes)
source: PlantVillage Dataset — Hughes & Salathé (2016), Frontiers in Plant Science

crops.economic_importance: One of the most commercially important fruits globally; used fresh, in juices, cider, vinegar, and desserts

crops.watering: Consistent moisture; mulching helps retain soil moisture
crops.economic_importance: High-value superfruit; rich in antioxidants (anthocyanins); used fresh, frozen, in bakery and health products
crops.notes: Only healthy class present in PlantVillage dataset; no diseased blueberry images included

crops.watering: Regular but avoid waterlogging; drip irrigation preferred
crops.economic_importance: Important fresh fruit and processing crop; used in jams, juices, liqueurs, and dried products

diseases_in_dataset.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on young leaves, shoots, and fruit surfaces; leaf curling and stunting
diseases_in_dataset.management: Sulfur-based fungicides, potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, proper air circulation

crops.economic_importance: World's largest crop by production; used for food, animal feed, biofuel (ethanol), starch, and industrial products

diseases_in_dataset.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot / Gray Leaf Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Rectangular grayish-tan lesions parallel to leaf veins; can cause premature senescence
diseases_in_dataset.management: Resistant hybrids, crop rotation, foliar fungicides (strobilurins)

diseases_in_dataset.name: Common Rust
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Small, circular to elongated brick-red powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces
diseases_in_dataset.management: Resistant varieties, fungicides (propiconazole) at early infection stages

diseases_in_dataset.name: Northern Leaf Blight
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Long, cigar-shaped gray-green to tan lesions on leaves; can cause significant yield loss
diseases_in_dataset.management: Resistant hybrids, fungicide application, crop rotation

crops.soil_type: Well-drained rocky or sandy loam, pH 5.5–6.5
crops.watering: Moderate; drip irrigation; deficit irrigation improves fruit quality
crops.economic_importance: Critical for wine, raisins, fresh fruit, and juice industries; one of the oldest cultivated crops

diseases_in_dataset.name: Black Rot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Circular tan lesions with dark borders on leaves; shriveled black mummified berries
diseases_in_dataset.management: Mancozeb, myclobutanil fungicides; sanitation; remove mummified berries

diseases_in_dataset.name: Esca (Black Measles)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Tiger-stripe patterns on leaves, dark berries, internal wood discoloration and decay
diseases_in_dataset.management: No effective chemical cure; remove and destroy infected vines; preventive wound protection

diseases_in_dataset.name: Leaf Blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spot)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Irregular dark brown spots on leaves with yellow halos; premature defoliation
diseases_in_dataset.management: Copper-based fungicides, proper canopy management

crops.soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam, pH 6.0–7.5
crops.economic_importance: Leading citrus crop globally; major source of vitamin C; used in juice, zest, essential oils, and fresh consumption

diseases_in_dataset.name: Huanglongbing (Citrus Greening)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Yellow shoots (Huanglongbing = yellow dragon disease), blotchy mottling, small lopsided bitter fruits, dieback
diseases_in_dataset.management: No cure; remove infected trees, control psyllid vector with insecticides, use certified disease-free nursery stock

crops.notes: Only one diseased class in PlantVillage; no healthy orange class included

crops.soil_type: Sandy loam to clay loam, pH 6.0–7.0, well-drained
crops.economic_importance: Important stone fruit; used fresh, canned, dried, in jams and juices

diseases_in_dataset.name: Bacterial Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown/purple with yellow halos; shot-hole appearance; sunken spots on fruit
diseases_in_dataset.management: Copper bactericides, resistant varieties, avoid overhead irrigation

crops.economic_importance: Important vegetable crop globally; high vitamin C content; used fresh, cooked, dried, and in condiments

diseases_in_dataset.name: Bacterial Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves turning brown/black with yellow halo; raised scab-like lesions on fruit
diseases_in_dataset.management: Copper bactericides, crop rotation, use certified disease-free seed, resistant varieties

crops.watering: Consistent moisture (500–700 mm/season); critical at tuber initiation
crops.economic_importance: Fourth largest food crop in the world; staple in many countries; used for food, starch, alcohol, and animal feed

diseases_in_dataset.name: Early Blight
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Dark brown lesions with concentric rings (target board pattern) on older leaves; yellowing and defoliation
diseases_in_dataset.management: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb fungicides; crop rotation; remove infected plant debris

diseases_in_dataset.name: Late Blight
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves with white sporulation underneath; rapidly spreads in cool wet conditions; brown rot in tubers
diseases_in_dataset.management: Metalaxyl, chlorothalonil; resistant varieties; avoid overhead irrigation; destroy infected plants

crops.growth_habit: Erect or arching canes, 1–2 m tall
crops.economic_importance: High-value berry crop; used fresh, frozen, in jams, juices, confectionery, and nutraceuticals

crops.watering: 500–700 mm/season; critical at flowering and pod fill
crops.economic_importance: World's most important oilseed and protein crop; used for oil, meal, tofu, soy milk, biodiesel, and livestock feed
crops.notes: Only healthy class in PlantVillage; no diseased soybean images included

crops.soil_type: Well-drained, fertile loam or sandy loam, pH 6.0–7.5
crops.watering: Regular deep watering; avoid wetting foliage
crops.economic_importance: Versatile vegetable grown worldwide; seeds also used for oil and snacks; important in subsistence and commercial farming

diseases_in_dataset.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaf surfaces; yellowing, premature leaf senescence; reduced photosynthesis
diseases_in_dataset.management: Sulfur fungicides, potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, resistant varieties, good air circulation

crops.notes: Only diseased class in PlantVillage; no healthy squash images included

crops.origin: Garden hybrid from North and South America
crops.growth_habit: Low-growing plant with runners, 15–30 cm tall
crops.soil_type: Sandy loam, well-drained, slightly acidic pH 5.5–6.5
crops.economic_importance: Top berry crop globally by fresh market value; used fresh, frozen, in jams, ice cream, and bakery products

diseases_in_dataset.name: Leaf Scorch
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Small dark purple to reddish irregular spots on upper leaf surface; centers may turn tan/gray; leaves appear scorched
diseases_in_dataset.management: Captan or myclobutanil fungicides; remove infected leaves; avoid overhead watering; use resistant cultivars

crops.watering: Consistent irrigation; mulching reduces water loss
crops.economic_importance: Most widely consumed vegetable globally; used fresh, canned, as sauce, paste, juice; major processing industry

diseases_in_dataset.name: Bacterial Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Small, water-soaked, greasy spots on leaves turning brown/black; spots on fruits; defoliation
diseases_in_dataset.management: Copper-based bactericides, avoid overhead irrigation, crop rotation, resistant varieties

diseases_in_dataset.name: Early Blight
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Dark brown bull's-eye lesions on older leaves; yellowing around spots; stem lesions; fruit rot at stem end
diseases_in_dataset.management: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb; remove lower infected leaves; crop rotation

diseases_in_dataset.name: Late Blight
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Greasy gray-green patches on leaves turning brown/black; white sporulation on undersides; fruit rot
diseases_in_dataset.management: Metalaxyl, copper fungicides; destroy infected plants; avoid wet conditions

diseases_in_dataset.name: Leaf Mold
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Pale green/yellow spots on upper leaf surface; olive-green to gray mold on undersides; mainly in greenhouses
diseases_in_dataset.management: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb; improve ventilation; reduce humidity below 85%

diseases_in_dataset.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Circular spots with dark brown borders, grayish-white centers, and tiny black dots (pycnidia) on lower leaves
diseases_in_dataset.management: Chlorothalonil, copper; remove infected leaves; mulch; avoid overhead watering

diseases_in_dataset.name: Spider Mites (Two-Spotted Spider Mite)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Fine stippling/bronzing on leaves; yellow speckling; webbing under leaves; eventual leaf drop
diseases_in_dataset.management: Abamectin, bifenazate; neem oil; predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis); increase humidity

diseases_in_dataset.name: Target Spot
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Round to irregular lesions with concentric rings resembling a target; yellowing and defoliation
diseases_in_dataset.management: Difenoconazole, chlorothalonil fungicides; crop rotation

diseases_in_dataset.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaves, stunted growth, flower drop, drastic yield loss
diseases_in_dataset.management: Control whitefly vector (imidacloprid, neem); reflective mulches; resistant varieties; remove infected plants

diseases_in_dataset.name: Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV)
diseases_in_dataset.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic on leaves; leaf distortion; stunting; reduced fruit quality
diseases_in_dataset.management: Use certified virus-free seed, heat treatment, disinfect tools; no direct chemical control
